shuffle_4_minus_control.scope: Partial development only: reused folds 0/1/2, one training seed; not protected confirmation, full OOF, competition scores or a preregistered study. Paired date-group bootstrap conditions on fixed trained models and excludes training-seed uncertainty and prior model-selection bias. Dates are proxies, not verified sites. Synthetic permutations add no independent biological observations. SSL latent loss cannot establish downstream benefit from more SSL steps.
